'''January 2001 Normal tournament (22 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 22 January 2001. [[Geoff Snider]] won it. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1659">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-22-geoffs-real-starwars-tourneyd1659/ geoffs-real-starwars-tourney], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 22 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-22-geoffs-real-starwars-tourneyd1659/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 January 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Geoff Snider]]
